title: Prevent. Useless: can’t move. Girl’s sweet light lips. Will happen too
html_source: Anxieties that Boylan will seduce mother AND daughter (Norris, M. Virgin and Veteran readings of Ulysses, p91).

anchor.text: Prevent. Useless: can't move. Girl's sweet light lips. Will happen too
anchor.prefix:
ow past. Mrs Marion. Reading, lying back now, counting the strands of her hair, smiling, braiding. 

 A soft qualm, regret, flowed down his backbone, increasing. Will happen, yes.
anchor.suffix:
. He felt the flowing qualm spread over him. Useless to move now. Lips kissed, kissing, kissed. Full gluey woman's lips. 

 Better where she is down there: away. Occupy her. Wanted
